effect.name: GM Posterize
effect.desc: Six different quantisers over one tone stage. Channel Levels clips each channel independently, Luma Bands keeps the hue and bands only the brightness, Ordered and Noise Dither dissolve the steps with a Bayer 8 lattice or a hash, Halftone Dots rebuilds the picture out of rotatable ink dots, and Riso Offset prints two shifted ink passes on top of each other. A duotone ramp can then map the result onto any two colours. Everything is built in LAYER space, so the pattern scales and rotates with the layer instead of sitting on the frame.
